name: architexture-detexture-ade20k-56
description: Exact 56-sample validation-only refined crop set used for the post-paper DeTexture ADE20K diagnostic. Validation-split only (excludes 697 training-prefixed crops) to avoid ADE20K train-set leakage into the TextureSAM baseline comparison. ARCHITEXTURE Stage-A: 56 samples, invariant mIoU=0.7435, ARI=0.5532.
rai:dataLimitations: Contains derived crops from ADE20K validation images. Only 56 validation-prefixed samples included; 697 training-prefixed crops excluded to avoid TextureSAM baseline contamination. Results should not be generalized beyond the texture-transition boundary task.
rai:dataBiases: Inherits biases from ADE20K scene composition, annotation conventions, and the DeTexture refined-variant filter. May overrepresent clean boundary cases. Validation-only split introduces selection bias relative to the full 753-entry gallery.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: ADE20K source images may contain incidental depictions of people in scene context. No biometric data, demographic labels, or intentionally personal information is included.
rai:dataUseCases: Research on texture-aware binary segmentation, two-mask partition-invariant evaluation, and post-paper diagnostic reproducibility for the DeTexture ADE20K validation route.
rai:notRecommendedUses: Training-split benchmark claims, general ADE20K scene understanding, object recognition, human identity tasks, surveillance, medical diagnosis, or safety-critical deployment.
prov:wasDerivedFrom: ADE20K dataset (MIT License, research use); DeTexture ADE20K pipeline (github.com/aviadcohz/detexture_ADE20K, commit c22d62ab7917a3e3acb5a45d8a4ecdf57e8aa108)
prov:wasGeneratedBy: DeTexture pipeline on ADE20K validation images producing paired binary texture-transition crops. Refined-variant gallery filter (valid_fraction_mean=0.997) selects 56 highest-quality validation-split crops. Two-mask GT: labels_a and labels_b define exclusive partitions.

distribution.name: manifest.csv
distribution.description: One row per sample: sample_id, image_path, labels_a_path, labels_b_path, split, valid_fraction
